candidates.source_name: Загальнодоступна інформаційна база даних НКЦПФР про ринок цінних паперів (stockmarket.gov.ua)
candidates.why_relevant: Legally mandated public disclosure database of the Ukrainian securities regulator (NSSMC/НКЦПФР). Any bank or payments company constituted as a joint-stock company files regular (annual/interim) and special information here. Its categorised participant index (issuers, prospectuses, large shareholdings, exchanges, traders) enumerates which financial entities exist and file — an actor-discovery layer independent of the NBU.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl the categorised participant sections and issuer feed pages; combine with the open-data XML API for bulk indexing; treat registration-gated views as a secondary manual path.
candidates.discovered_via_method: seed query + snowball from NSSMC databases page

candidates.source_name: SMIDA — база даних «Емітенти» (issuer index, ~20 000 issuers since 2003)
candidates.why_relevant: The issuer index itself: approximately 20,000 issuers that have published regular and irregular information since 2003. Filtering/searching by EDRPOU and name yields the complete population of Ukrainian banks and financial companies constituted as JSCs — the actor-enumeration backbone for workstream A1.

candidates.source_name: SMIDA — «Опублікування регульованої інформації» feed (post-01/07/2021 regulated-information stream)
candidates.why_relevant: The live chronological stream of regulated information filed by issuers and providers of security: interim and annual financial disclosures, special/irregular corporate announcements, emission decisions, auditor reports and prospectuses. Filterable by legal-entity name, EDRPOU, report type (100+ categories) and date range — the primary monitoring feed for bank/payments issuer events.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll /db/feed with EDRPOU filter for the watchlist of banks/payments issuers daily; download the linked XML plus qualified-signature files from /files/feed/[date]/[uuid]/.

negative_findings.description: I found no evidence of a sector/KVED or 'banks only' filter within the SMIDA issuer database or the stockmarket.gov.ua participant index. The fetched /db/emitent page did not document search parameters, filters or URL query structure.
negative_findings.result_summary: Issuer enumeration for banking/payments will have to be done by joining EDRPOU codes from external registers (NBU licensed banks, payment-institution registers, ЄДР) against the issuer index, not by a native sector filter.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Materially changes the collection design: the disclosure system is a confirmation and enrichment layer keyed by EDRPOU, not a self-serve sector screen.

negative_findings.description: The stockmarket.gov.ua open-data API index page states that data is available through 30 June 2021, matching the site's 'Опублікування регульованої інформації (до 30/06/2021)' archive label.
negative_findings.result_summary: The v1 API appears to be a historical archive; post-July-2021 regulated information appears to flow through the SMIDA /db/feed stream and authorised regulated-information publishers instead. I did not find a documented successor API.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A pipeline built only on the v1 API would silently stop at mid-2021 and miss all recent bank filings.

negative_findings.description: Ukrainian-language searching for the register of 'осіб, які провадять діяльність з оприлюднення регульованої інформації' returned the legal framework (Положення z1307-23) and general descriptions, but I did not locate a public list page enumerating the licensed publishers.
negative_findings.result_summary: The existence of the role is confirmed by regulation; the enumerated register was not found in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: If issuers may publish via multiple authorised publishers, monitoring only SMIDA may leave gaps for some bank issuers.

negative_findings.description: stockmarket.gov.ua lists a 'Prospectuses' category in its participant navigation, but I did not find a documented direct URL for a searchable prospectus register, and searches for a bank bond prospectus register returned only procedural/administrative-service pages.
negative_findings.result_summary: Prospectus discovery is currently hypothesised to run through the stockmarket.gov.ua prospectus section, the State Register of Securities Issues and the /db/feed 'проспект' report type — none confirmed as a standalone register UI.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Bond prospectuses are the richest single artefact for a bank's funding strategy and risk disclosures; an unresolved access path is a real gap.

negative_findings.description: stockmarket.gov.ua exposes /db/login and /registration/user; the login page states that general information about issuers, exchanges, traders and rating agencies is freely accessible while 'перегляд інформації' and the pre-30/06/2021 disclosure-subject area use authorisation forms.
negative_findings.result_summary: Most of the value appears public, but some views may require a free account. Not tested — I did not create an account.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection design should assume an anonymous path first and flag any view that turns out to be account-gated rather than assuming the whole database is open.

negative_findings.description: Ukrainian-language searching linking the NSSMC disclosure system to payments companies (платіжні установи, фінансові компанії) surfaced no payments-specific disclosure pathway; results were dominated by banks and general corporate issuers.
negative_findings.result_summary: Non-bank payments firms in Ukraine are typically LLCs rather than joint-stock companies and so mostly fall outside issuer disclosure, unless they issue bonds.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: This cell should be treated as strong for banks and weak for pure payments actors; payments coverage must come from NBU/other registers.

coverage_gaps.description: No confirmed machine-readable successor to the v1 open-data API for regulated information published after 30/06/2021.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Probe smida.gov.ua for an API or structured export behind /db/feed (RSS/JSON/XML), and inspect the file paths /files/feed/[date]/[uuid]/ for a deterministic naming convention that permits bulk retrieval.

coverage_gaps.description: No sector filter in the issuer index means the bank/payments issuer population is not yet enumerated.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build an EDRPOU watchlist from the NBU register of licensed banks and payment-service providers, then resolve each against smida.gov.ua/db/emitent and /db/prof to produce the definitive issuer subset.

coverage_gaps.description: Bond prospectus retrieval path for bank issuers is hypothesised, not confirmed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Open the stockmarket.gov.ua 'Проспекти' navigation node and the /db/feed report-type dropdown, identify the exact prospectus report-type code, and test a filtered query for a known bank bond issuer.

coverage_gaps.description: The disclosure database and all filings are Ukrainian-only; NSSMC's English site covers policy and press but not filing content.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Plan for Ukrainian-language parsing and a controlled uk→en term map for filing types (річна інформація, проміжна інформація, особлива інформація, проспект, звіт про управління).

coverage_gaps.description: Regulated information may be published via multiple authorised publishers, and only SMIDA has been identified.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Locate the NSSMC register of authorised regulated-information publishers (via the Положення z1307-23 references and the NSSMC licensing section) and add each publisher's feed to the monitoring set.

coverage_gaps.description: Non-bank payments companies are largely outside the issuer disclosure perimeter.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Do not rely on this cell for payments-actor discovery; flag to the coordinating cells that NBU registers and the ЄДР are the correct venue, and use this cell only where a payments firm has issued bonds.

brief: Ukraine's securities-regulator disclosure layer is a two-site system: NSSMC (nssmc.gov.ua) sets the rules and publishes decisions, while the statutory content lives in the public database stockmarket.gov.ua and its operating agency SMIDA (smida.gov.ua), which runs the issuer index (~20,000 issuers since 2003), the live regulated-information feed, ESCRIN quarterly/special disclosures, the State Register of Securities Issues, the shareholder-stake database and the violations register. For any bank constituted as a joint-stock company this is a legally mandated, high-credibility filing venue independent of the NBU, and the issuer index doubles as an actor-enumeration pointer — though it has no sector filter, so the bank population must be resolved by EDRPOU joins against NBU registers. The most important structural caveat is temporal: the open-data v1 API and the stockmarket.gov.ua publication archive are documented as covering only through 30 June 2021, after which regulated information flows through SMIDA's feed and authorised publishers, and no successor API has been confirmed. Coverage is strong for banks and bond issuers and weak for non-bank payments firms, which are typically LLCs outside the issuer disclosure perimeter.
